payload.title: Close owned serving readiness streams on read failure cancellation and timeout
payload.summary: P2: both public serving status/wait paths leave their opened StreamWriter unclosed when read raises OSError, cancellation or timeout. Six deterministic stream cases plus a real ephemeral local HTTP sink cancellation demonstrate missing finally settlement. Under retained fixture reference actual writer is_closingFalse after task cancellation settles. This proves failure to release the owned connection at operation boundary, not leaked inference process or permanent OS leak. Repair existing helpers; preserve original failure/cancellation, await close appropriately and do not retry model/process work. Baseline a7a49cc18f3b40a5bf4e3897ca30d9a5cddc30d1. Acceptance: Both serving adapters settle owned stream close after error/cancel/readiness timeout and success; original outcomes preserved; real loopback cancellation control; no stale waiter/automatic external retry. Separate from delivered Command collector37a647f2.
payload.benefit: Make the existing supported boundary conservative and reliable without inventing new lifecycle or authority.
payload.uncertainty: Deterministic maintained-call probes, not live model/GPU/Docker proof. Production correction is not authorized by this audit; preserve ownership and public compatibility.
dependencies: Existing ADR-0001 ModelInteraction/Serving ownership and current public error/JSON/config contracts; no new architectural approval implied.
